sentences.en: The President says we must beef up our military forces.
sentences.zh: 总统说我们必须加强军事力量。

sentences.en: Our diplomacy and our military strategy were clearly in contradiction.
sentences.zh: 我们的外交政策和军事战略明显存在矛盾。

sentences.en: The British had military bases along New York's Hudson River.
sentences.zh: 英国在纽约哈德逊河沿岸设有军事基地。

senses.zh: 军事的，军队的；陆军的；军人般的，军人作风的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：milit（战斗）+ary（…的）→军事的
